_about: Hand review of Claude's enriched words. Keyed by the enriched key (spelling|homograph|국립국어원 POS). Fields here replace Claude's; "pronounced": "" removes a pronunciation; "exclude" holds a word back (with the reason).

거짓말||명.note: Common: 거짓말을 하다 (to tell a lie).

전혀|1|부.note: Used with negative verbs: 전혀 모르다 (to not know at all). Often softened to [저녀] in fast speech.

결혼하다||동.note: Pattern: ~와/과 결혼하다 (to marry someone). Often softened to [겨로나다] in fast speech.

재밌다||형.meaning: to be fun (casual, short for 재미있다)

내다|2|동.meaning: to pay; to put out; to submit

들다|1|동.meaning: to go in; to cost; to stay (at)
들다|1|동.note: 마음에 들다 = to like (literally: to enter one's heart).
